title: Prana common definitions
description: Shared building blocks referenced by every other Prana schema. Registered under this $id by the validator, which resolves it from schema/common.schema.json on disk.

Gtin14.description: Canonical product key. Every barcode format is zero-padded to 14 digits so the same product can never be stored twice under EAN-13 and UPC-A. The final digit is a check digit and is verified by the validator, not by this schema.

PrintedBarcode.description: The digits exactly as printed under the barcode on the packet, without padding, so the app can show the user what they are looking at.

Slug.description: A stable machine identifier that references another record, for example a brand or a canonical ingredient. Lower case, hyphen separated.

IsoDate.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Times are deliberately not stored. Nothing in this project needs sub-day precision, and a date keeps diffs readable.

LanguageCode.description: ISO 639-1 where one exists, otherwise ISO 639-3.

LocalizedText.description: Optional translations, keyed by language code. Empty until Phase 2. Canonical data stays language neutral, so nothing here is ever required for lookup or analysis.

Quantity.description: A measured amount with an explicit unit. There is no default unit anywhere in this schema, because an implied unit is how a per-serving value silently becomes a per-100g value.

Confidence.description: How much the evidence supports the value. There is no unknown level here, because an unknown value is not recorded at all. See the unknown model in docs/PRODUCT_SCHEMA.md.

SourceType.description: Ranked from most to least authoritative. packaging means a photograph of the actual packet. community means a contributor typed it in without an attachable artefact.

Source.description: One piece of evidence. Sources are declared once per record and referenced by id from the provenance map, so a single photograph of a nutrition panel is not repeated eleven times.

id.description: Record-local identifier, s1, s2 and so on. Not globally meaningful.

url.description: Where the evidence lives, when the source licence permits recording it. HTTPS only.

licence.description: The licence the source data is under, as recorded in DATA_SOURCES.md. Required for anything imported, because it decides whether we may redistribute it.

ProvenancePath.description: A dotted path into this record, for example name, ingredients, nutrition[0], or nutrition[0].values.sugars_g. A path covers itself and everything beneath it.

source.description: Id of an entry in this record sources array.

Provenance.description: Maps paths in this record to the evidence behind them. A path covers everything beneath it, so one entry for nutrition[0] backs the whole panel. The validator rejects any published value that no path covers, which is what keeps this map honest while contributions stay small.

Conflict.description: A recorded disagreement between sources. Conflicts are never averaged away. They are stored, they lower confidence, and the app shows them.

resolution.description: unresolved means the record must not be published as verified.

status.description: verified means evidence and validation both passed. unverified means it is in the repository but must not be presented as trusted. disputed means an unresolved conflict exists.
